name: message-thread-reveal
title: Message Thread Reveal
description: A text conversation plays out in iMessage: bubbles popping in, typing indicators, a typed reply in the input bar, a shared link card, emoji, delivered receipts, the thread stacking up from the bottom. Every message, the link card and six beat times are variables; placement full (header with the contact) or top / bottom (a black chat card); holds the last message to the end of the mount.
author: Miao Yang
